title: Path to independent physician practice

stages.title: High-school exploration
stages.note: Explore science, service, teamwork, patient-facing environments, and the realities of long training without treating high school as premedical school.

stages.title: Undergraduate degree
stages.note: Complete a bachelor's degree, major requirements, medical-school preparation, and meaningful experiences.

stages.title: MCAT and medical-school application
stages.note: Timing varies; gap years are common and not failures.

stages.title: Medical school
stages.note: Classroom, laboratory, clinical skills, and rotations lead toward residency.

stages.title: Residency
stages.note: Length varies by specialty; some sources describe longer training for selected paths.

stages.title: Optional fellowship
stages.note: Subspecialty training is optional and varies.

stages.title: Licensure, practice, and continuing education
stages.note: Independent practice responsibilities and lifelong learning continue.

reflectionPrompts: Which parts of the work—not the title—appeal to you?
How do you feel about repeated high-stakes learning and feedback?
What would you want to observe in real clinical work before deciding?
